title: Custom eggless cake pickup before 7am for Rouse Hill and Vineyard families
summary:
Riverstone opens at 6am on weekdays. That's not for us — that's for the parent who needs a birthday cake before the school run.

Custom eggless cakes, ready for pickup before 7am, no rush. Rouse Hill and Vineyard families order through WhatsApp, choose from 15 flavours and six sizes, and collect on their way past Riverstone Shopping Centre. Free parking at the centre, which is why pickup takes minutes, not a detour.

100% eggless. Not some cakes — every cake. 48 hours minimum notice, because that's what fresh baking actually takes.

Order via WhatsApp: +61 425 697 725.
keywords: birthday cake pickup before school run
